'''Chris Hines''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Gold 8 in the Tatooine region, from Las Vegas, Nevada.<ref name="decsq-tatooine" /> His slot was later marked Retired.<ref name="sm-fan" />
